evidence_summary: RYR2 functions as a tetrameric sarcoplasmic-reticulum calcium-release channel in cardiac excitation-contraction coupling.
af3_design_note: Use existing RYR2 structural context and/or domain-level jobs. Full-length tetramer is too large.

evidence_summary: FKBP1B/calstabin-2 is a direct RYR2-associated regulatory subunit with UniProt/IntAct, Reactome, and RCSB support.
af3_design_note: Prioritize RYR2 domain/region containing FKBP1B binding context or use experimentally resolved template-informed design if feasible.

evidence_summary: Calmodulin regulates RYR2 activity; human RYR2 structures exist with calmodulin, and local calmodulin-binding domains can be modeled.
af3_design_note: Use CaM-binding domain job(s), not full-length RYR2. CALM1 can proxy calmodulin sequence; CALM2/CALM3 variants can be mapped separately with caution.

evidence_summary: CALM2 and CALM3 encode calmodulin proteins closely related to CALM1; disease variants may map onto same calmodulin chain model, but gene-specific provenance must be preserved.
af3_design_note: Do not submit redundant CALM jobs unless isoform/provenance question requires it.

evidence_summary: CASQ2 is the cardiac sarcoplasmic-reticulum calcium buffer in the RYR2 calcium-release context; Reactome links CASQ/TRDN/RYR complexes.
af3_design_note: Model CASQ2-TRDN first; direct full CASQ2-RYR2 may be too indirect/large unless a known RYR2 luminal domain boundary is chosen.

evidence_summary: Triadin links SR calcium-release complex biology and is in Reactome RYR/CASQ/TRDN context.
af3_design_note: CASQ2-TRDN is compact and already planned; RYR2 inclusion requires luminal domain design.

evidence_summary: RYR2 mediates calcium release and is regulated by calcium/calmodulin state; calcium context may be relevant in selected domain jobs.
af3_design_note: Do not add Ca2+ generically to every RYR2 job; include only when the complex design has a defined calcium/CaM question.

evidence_summary: Reported RYR2 regulator in UniProt-like subunit text, but not yet curated in the local AF3 manifest for this gene.
af3_design_note: Keep in candidate list, but do not make primary AF3 job until evidence/cardiac specificity is reviewed.

evidence_summary: RYR2 is reported in a regulatory complex with PKA catalytic/regulatory subunits, AKAP6, and phosphatases, but this is PTM/regulatory-state biology.
af3_design_note: Do not include in baseline AF3. Consider later after phosphorylation/PTM strategy is defined.
